## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) and a MAJOR divergence among large caps (ORCL/GOOGL/AVGO showing RECOVERY vs NVDA/MSFT ABOVE TREND) — suppress strong regime calls.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +2.96%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +5.85% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY. Financials strong: C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +10.46%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing strength: BA (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +21.80%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +8.41% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: PSX (1W: -2.71% | 1M: -3.60%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples weak: PG (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND. Utilities under pressure and not leading the market.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +27.29%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.55% | 1M: +0.00%) RECOVERY. Leadership concentration: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PG (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -6.48%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -2.64% | 1M: +3.86%) CORRECTION, PSX (1W: -2.71% | 1M: -3.60%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -2.82% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in staples and select industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large caps with 1W up / 1M down — tactical follow-through needed before committing size.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with narrow leadership and short-term reversals. NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +2.96%) ABOVE TREND show strength, while ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, AVGO (1W: +7.63% | 1M: -7.16%) RECOVERY and GOOGL (1W: +5.85% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY indicate short-term rotational noise; sector breadth: Technology positive (19 stocks total).

8. Financials Outlook?
Healthy and broad leadership: C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +10.46%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +7.85%) ABOVE TREND — Financials show cyclical/value characteristics and confirm part of the market lift.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed/defensive tilt with selective strength. MRK (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +6.93%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +0.64%) ABOVE TREND vs PFE (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -1.21% | 1M: +1.48%) CORRECTION — monitor clinical/news catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and select Industrials given broad 1M confirmation, reduce exposure to high-multiple Tech names showing RECOVERY patterns (ORCL, AVGO, GOOGL) until follow-through, and monitor NVDA/MSFT for sustained breakout confirmation. Style: Growth/Momentum leadership but narrow — be selective and size cautiously.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +27.29%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -2.50%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND — watch sentiment-driven downside.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (Breadth positive; multiple names ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Consumer Staples and Utilities (lagging on 1W and negative sentiment in utilities).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch hold above the recent 1W high for continuation; ORCL: needs follow-through after RECOVERY move to validate reversal; JPM: sustain above 1M uptrend to confirm Financials extension; PEP/PG: watch failing support on continued weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (+80): FDA clearance expansion headline; cross-ref with price: healthcare tailwind, monitor for confirmation. ORCL (+75): OpenAI ties headline; price RECOVERY (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) — bullish news but short-term divergence vs month, watch follow-through. ABT (+75): FDA win headline; price showing strength and confirms sentiment.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
D (-75): govt halting offshore wind; utilities pressure confirming sector weakness. PFE (-65): trial death/tighter guidance; price BELOW TREND (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -0.75%) — bearish sentiment confirmed. TSLA (-55): probe headlines but TSLA is ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +16.19%) — notable divergence, monitor for distribution signs.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with Growth/Momentum leadership. NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY showing strength. Key risk: narrow tech concentration and MAJOR divergence across megacaps plus mixed sentiment (ORCL/GOOGL bullish headlines vs mixed 1M performance) — monitor for follow-through.
